title: Predicting Lexical Complexity in English Texts: The Complex 2.0 Dataset
reasoning: The paper introduces a new dataset, CompLex 2.0, for benchmarking lexical complexity prediction. One of the three source text genres chosen for this dataset is explicitly religious text, specifically the "World English Bible translation". The paper then uses this data, including the religious texts, to conduct experiments and analyze lexical complexity. Therefore, the work has a component of benchmarking using religious texts as a core part of its methodology and contribution.
